messages:
olivia_support: Heads up — we're getting a cluster of 503 / timeouts against hosted inference endpoints since ~20:36 UTC. Multiple customers reporting errors and increased p95. I opened the incident channel, joining now.

infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-317 created. Priority: P1. Auto-runbooks attached: hosted-inference-5xx.

jordan_oncall: ACK. Pulling logs and traces. Any recent deploys? @sam_runtime @maria_eng

sam_runtime: We pushed runtime image 1.12.0 at 20:35 that changed default max_seq to 4096 (was 2048). Early signal: node shard-12 reporting kv-cache miss storms and connection queue saturation.

maria_eng: Yep that deploy contains the seqlen default bump + a small kernel path optimization. We didn't hit this path in canary — apparently only at high concurrent long-context requests.

alexa_sre: Impact: 503s from runtime workers + upstream gateway timeouts. Workarounds in-flight: 1) rollback runtime image to 1.11.4 2) route heavy seq requests to model-medium fallback 3) throttle inflight on gateway. Executing rollback now.

infra-bot: Rollback job started: deploy/runtime@eu-west -> image:1.11.4 (triggered by alexa_sre).

olivia_support: Customer comms posted to status page and DMs to affected accounts (acct-112, acct-455). Told them we're investigating and offered temporary routing guidance.

sam_runtime: Quick repro notes (from logs):
```
2026-03-17T20:37:12Z shard-12 runtime ERROR kv_cache: miss_storm seq_len=4096 inflight=48 kernelqueue=96
2026-03-17T20:37:13Z shard-12 runtime WARN conn-pool: queue_exhausted backend_wait=1200ms
2026-03-17T20:37:14Z shard-12 runtime ERROR http: 502 -> gateway
```
Looks like high seq length triggers more KV misses -> GC/backpressure -> worker queues fill -> 5xx.

jordan_oncall: Rollback progress? Any effect on p95?

alexa_sre: Rollback completed on eu-west and us-east at 20:50. Autoscaler caps lowered as emergency throttle. p95 latency dropped ~40% and 503 rate fell to baseline within 6m. Still seeing a few residual timeouts in older hosts.

sam_runtime: Temporary mitigation implemented: forced max_seq cap at gateway level to 2048 for hosted tier and explicit routing rule to fallback-model-medium for requests with seq>2048. Patch applied:
```
kubectl -n hosting set env deploy/gateway MAX_SEQ_OVERRIDE=2048
kubectl -n hosting rollout restart deploy/gateway
```

maria_eng: Root cause hypothesis: default seqlen bump in runtime image combined with a kernel path that increases KV cache churn for >2048 tokens. This was a regression in model-serving optimizations; not caught by current perf regression tests since they didn't exercise high-concurrency, long-context workload.

ben_docs: Note for postmortem: include timeline, customer impact, exact commit IDs, and which customers were affected. Also include a link to status update.

jordan_oncall: Current action items (short):
- revert default seqlen change in runtime config repo (owner: maria_eng)
- add canary test for seqlen=4096 with concurrent load (owner: sam_runtime)
- add automated alert for kv_cache miss_storm rate > 0.3% (owner: alexa_sre)
- add routing fallback in control plane for long-context requests (owner: infra)

sam_runtime: Also pushing long-term: add load test harness that simulates multi-tenant long-context fanout at scale and a unit perf test that runs on PR for seqlen-related changes.

olivia_support: I scheduled a postmortem meeting 2026-03-18 16:00 UTC. We should prepare customer timeline and comms template.

alexa_sre: I'll file the postmortem doc and assign action items. Quick note: emergency support credit approved for heavily impacted customers.

infra-bot: Incident INC-2026-317 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Total duration 00:34:01.

jordan_oncall: Closing notes before handoff: rollback validated, fallback routing remains, added alerting and throttles. Major follow-ups: test coverage and default config rollback.

olivia_support: Thanks everyone. Will follow up in postmortem with customer impact and exact ASIDs. :thumbsup:

ben_docs: I'll draft the postmortem doc and link action tracker.

sam_runtime: Final: PR created to revert default (repo: runtime-config #422), canary plan in #canary-playbooks.

jordan_oncall: Marking resolved in channel. If any regressions appear ping @oncall immediately.
